name: spreadsheetSetActiveCell
description: Sets the active cell of the active sheet in a spreadsheet workbook. Rows and columns are 1-based (row 1, column 1 = cell A1). The fluent member form is setActiveCell(row, column).

params.name: row
params.description: 1-based row index of the active cell.

params.name: column
params.description: 1-based column index of the active cell.

examples.title: Move the active cell
examples.description: Make C4 the active cell of the active sheet.
